course.title: Digital Logic Design
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: What is meant by digital logic families? Design the following functions using CMOS logic (10)
(i) F1 = (A + B + C)· D (ii) F2 = (A + BC + DEF)
You can use CMOS NAND or CMOS NOR logic to design these functions.
